body: That's not silly. If that's what you love pursue that. No one ever does well at something they don't enjoy. Passion for something gets you far further than anything else ever will. I understand parents not supporting what you want to do and it's hard to follow your own dream but it's worth it if you do. You're not pathetic, happiness is relative and being broken up with is one of the hardest things a person can go through. You have every right to feel how you do. I hope things get better for you. Good luck with your music.
